data.title: Siraj Tower
data.about:
Discover the beauty of Spanish and Roman architecture in our newest residential community, Siraj Tower. With a focus on balance and symmetry, this captivating 30-story tower is one of the most sought-after residential buildings in the area. 

Our luxurious studio, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments are designed with the finest building materials and fittings. They are fully furnished with high-quality furniture for an elevated living experience.

location_tile.title: Located in the heart of Arjan, Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The residential community is located in the heart of Arjan, a vibrant and family-friendly district within Dubailand. Arjan borders Al Barsha South to the north and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road to the south. The road network is fully developed and offers quick and easy access to the main areas of Dubai. Arjan offers a variety of amenities and facilities, including residential complexes, commercial buildings, international schools, hospitals, and retail developments. With its central location, Arjan is the perfect place to call home for those seeking a vibrant community with easy access to the rest of Dubai.

  • 08 minutes from the Dubai Hills Mall
  • 15 minutes from the JBR
  • 23 minutes from the Dubai mall
  • 25 minutes from the Al Maktoum Airport
